title.narrative: Stöd till Kosova Democratic Institute-Transparency International Kosova
Support to Kosova Democratic Institute-Transparency International Kosova

description.narrative:
Projektets övergripande mål är att öka den offentliga integriteten och ansvarsskyldigheten genom att främja medborgaraktivism i kampen mot korruption. Genom en ökad medborgaraktivism lyfts problemen till statliga institutioner för att vidta åtgärder och, om nödvändigt, förbättra antikorruptionsstandarder och praxis.
Projektets målgrupper är ungdomar, vittnen och offer av korruption, civilsamhällesorganisationer, media, statliga institutioner och offentliga myndigheter.

The project's overall objective is to enhance public integrity and accountability by promoting civic activism in combating corruption. In pursuing this impact goal, KDI-Transparency International Kosova aims for state institutions to undertake actions that enhance integrity by implementing and, if needed, improving anti-corruption standards and practices influenced by civic activism. KDI has designed three specific objectives (outcomes) which collectively will contribute to the improvements in the fight against corruption by facilitating a climate in which youth, witnesses and victims of corruption, state institutions, civil society organizations, and media, are willing to openly discuss, learn, cooperate and work towards solutions influencing improved public integrity.
Outcome 1 - To increase the engagement of young generations of community-based leaders in the prevention of corruption. Outcome 2 - To enhance public integrity values, practices and standards by using evidence­based data by citizens, victims and witnesses of corruption. Outcome 3 -­ To strengthen prevention and determent of corruption through increased civil society, media and state institutions cooperation and collective endeavors of the program.

The project's overall objective is to enhance public integrity and accountability by promoting civic activism in combating corruption. By pursuing this impact goal, KDI-TI Kosova aims for state institutions to undertake actions that enhance integrity by implementing and, if needed, improving anticorruption standards and practices influenced by civic activism. KDI-TI Kosova has designed three specific objectives (outcomes) which collectively will contribute to the improvements in the fight against corruption: Outcome 1 - To increase the engagement of young generations of community-based leaders in the prevention of corruption. Outcome 2 - To enhance public integrity values, practices and standards by using evidencebased data by citizens, victims and witnesses of corruption. Outcome 3 - To strengthen prevention and determent of corruption through increased civil society, media and state institutions cooperation and collective endeavors of the program. The proposed project is concentrated in the empowerment and interaction of five key target groups (youth, witnesses and victims of corruption, civil society organizations, media, and state institutions), which is instrumental for creating platforms to push for public integrity to improve institutional accountability and ownership. This approach will support the creation of a critical mass which will be able to influence public discourse and drive action against political corruption.

description.narrative:
During 2024, KDI organized 16 training sessions across eight regions of Kosovo. A total of 438 young participants attended a two-day anti-corruption training, with 62.47% being young women, showing strong engagement and commitment. KDI engaged the municipal education directorates and local partners to disseminate the call and encourage participation. The sessions included presentations, discussions, case studies, and exercises to strengthen civic activism.
KDI was unable to implement the planned online anti-corruption training program due to the low level of interest among youth, who prefer online platforms for personal use rather than structured learning. Nevertheless, KDI is dedicated to finding effective ways to engage youth in anti-corruption education through digital platforms.
Throughout 2024, KDI conducted a comprehensive public awareness campaign to educate citizens about their rights and the free legal assistance services offered by its Advocacy and Legal Advice Center (ALAC). A total of 74 cases were received, including labor law violations and whistleblower grievances. There was a significant increase in cases from public institution employees, with 48.6% of submissions coming from women. KDI achieved a 78% resolution rate for these cases, surpassing the target of 40%. The first story-case book, titled When Institutions Remain Silent and Justice is Delayed, was published, showcasing cases reported through ALAC.
During this reporting period, KDI closely monitored three laws: the Law on the Protection of Whistleblowers, the Law on the Financing of Political Entities, and legislation related to justice reform, particularly the Law on the Kosovo Prosecutorial Council. Through its Advocacy and Legal Advice Center, KDI published an in-depth report titled (Non) Implementation of the Law on Protection of Whistleblowers in Central Public Enterprises in Kosovo. A roundtable discussion with high-level participants revealed that, despite the existing legal framework, the laws implementation remains superficial and inconsistent.
KDI also launched the report The Wallets of the Main Political Parties in Kosovo 3.0, providing a detailed analysis of the financial reports submitted by political parties for 2023. The roundtable served as a timely platform to examine transparency and regulatory gaps in political party financing.
In 2024, KDI initiated the Thematic Anti-Corruption Forum, an informal mechanism designed to enhance cooperation between civil society, media, and public institutions in the fight against corruption. The Forum aimed to coordinate advocacy efforts, launch joint initiatives, and develop informed recommendations to strengthen transparency and political integrity in Kosovo. Despite delays and complications, including the temporary withdrawal of some members, KDI continued the process with remaining members and sought new ones to ensure continuity and expansion.
